newsitem.title: GERMANY: Toepfer sees EU 1996 grain crop at 200 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Toepfer sees EU 1996 grain crop at 200 mln T.

text.p: Grain trader Alfred C Toepfer said the 1996 European Union grain crop should total 200 million tonnes, 25 million tonnes more than last year's and 13 million more than expected in July.
It cited an area increase by five percent to 36.4 million hectares and yield rises by 10 percent to 5.5 tonnes per hectare over last year.
EU farmers lobby COPA earlier this week put the grain crop in the 15 member states at 205.1 million tonnes compared with its own 1995 estimate of 175.4 million.
Within the Toepfer total, soft wheat was at 90 million (80.5 million 1995), durum wheat 7.5 (6.2), barley 53 (44), of which spring barley 24 million (18), maize 33 (29).
The remainder of the total, which was not described in detail, was oats, triticale, rye, sorghum and mixed grains.
Grain feeding would rise in the 1996/97 season because of the high availability and an estimated 55 million tonnes would be left for export or stockbuilding, Toepfer said.
